question: A bucket in the shape of the frustum of a cone has its top and bottom radii as 20 cm and 10 cm, respectively. The depth of the bucket is 24 cm. The capacity of the bucket is: (Take π = {frac{{22}}{7}})
solution:
Given:

The bucket has its top (R) and bottom (r) radii as 20 cm and 10 cm.

The depth (H) of the bucket is 24 cm.

Concept used:

The volume of the frustum of a cone = {1 over 3} times pi (R² + Rr +r²) times H

Where R and r are the top and bottom radii respectively and H is height/depth.
